title: Witnesses to Truth
author: Edward Hoare

authorInfo.bio: Edward Hoare (1812–1894) is the credited author of this historical edition. The source reference provides their catalogue and biographical references.
authorInfo.edition: Complete source text and original edition credits retained.

description: "Witnesses to Truth" by Edward Hoare is a theological discourse written in the late 19th century. This work engages with the challenges of faith, particularly the difficulties presented by scripture, and seeks to affirm the truth of Christian beliefs through various testimonies, including historical, geographical, and prophetic evidences.
